title: New /demo route has no parse test (every other route in router.gleam has one)
evidence:
["demo"] -> Demo
    ["dashboard"] -> Dashboard
    ["archived"] -> ArchivedVacancies
    ["login"] -> Login
    ["signup"] -> Signup
    ["forgot-password"] -> ForgotPassword
(client/test/client_test.gleam has parse_dashboard_test, parse_login_test, parse_signup_test, parse_vacancy_create_test etc. — `grep -n "parse_demo\|/demo" client/test/client_test.gleam` returns zero hits)
detail: The new Demo route arm in the modem parser is untested; a regression (e.g. segment reorder, typo) would silently land demo visitors on NotFound/Landing with no test failure. New route without matching coverage.
recommended_fix: Add `parse_demo_test` asserting `make_uri("/demo") |> router.parse |> should.equal(routes.Demo)` alongside the existing route-parse tests in client_test.gleam.

title: Breadcrumb demo branch (home link swaps to /demo, Demo segment) has zero test coverage
detail: The entire point of the new `demo` parameter — keeping in-demo breadcrumbs inside the sandbox — is exercised by no test; all five updated breadcrumb tests only pin the pre-existing False path. New behaviour branch, zero coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a test calling view_breadcrumb(routes.VacancyDetail("v1"), ..., demo: True) asserting the home href is /demo, plus one asserting routes.Demo renders the single 'Demo' segment.

title: Shell demo branches (settings link hidden, 'Exit demo' label) untested — payment-surface-hiding has no pin
detail: Hiding the settings/billing surface in demo is part of the 'no Stripe reachable from demo mode' scope guard, yet the only shell-level demo assertion in the suite is `html |> string.contains("demo-banner") |> should.be_true` (demo_flow_test.gleam:56). A regression restoring the settings link in demo would pass all tests.
recommended_fix: Add a shell view test with demo_mode: True asserting settings-link and mobile-nav-settings testids are absent and 'Exit demo' is present.

title: Landing demo entry CTAs (hero/nav/mobile — acceptance criterion 1) have no test assertions
evidence:
demo_cta_button(
              "cta-try-demo-hero",
              "Try the demo",
              "px-8 py-3.5 text-lg",
            ),
(plus nav_link("nav-try-demo", "/demo", "Try the demo") at :207 and mobile_menu_link("nav-try-demo-mobile", ...) at :268). Existing landing tests assert only: html |> string.contains("data-testid=\"page-landing\"") / "landing-hero" / "landing-pricing" / footer — grep for "cta-try-demo\|nav-try-demo" in client/test/ returns zero hits.
detail: The ungated first-fold demo entry is acceptance criterion 1 of the briefing, but no test asserts the CTA renders or points at /demo; a dropped link or wrong href would ship green.
recommended_fix: Extend landing view tests to assert cta-try-demo-hero and nav-try-demo testids render with href="/demo".

title: demo_api effect execution uncovered: tests hand-feed responses, and the claimed bug-hunt E2E scenario does not exist
detail: If demo_api.deliver (effect.from dispatch) stopped firing, every unit test would still pass because responses are fed manually; the comment claims bug-hunt covers this, but no demo scenario file exists. Effect-execution gap covered only by manual browser verification.
recommended_fix: Check in a bug-hunt YAML scenario driving /demo (dashboard loads, vacancy detail, reset) so the claimed E2E coverage is real, or drop the comment's claim.

title: Refresh/boot path (init → is_demo_route → enter_demo) untested; tests hand-construct the seeded model
detail: Reset and exit are well tested, but the refresh-wipe pillar's executable half — init re-seeding via enter_demo and the v-prefix is_demo_route deep-link heuristic — is invoked by no test; a regression there (e.g. forgetting demo_store on boot) fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test for is_demo_route over Demo/vacancy-deep-link/archived routes, and if feasible invoke init with a stubbed /demo URI asserting demo_mode/demo_store are set.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: Pillar verification: (1) CI lint at .github/workflows/test.yml:130-143 (`VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" ...)` + gleam/fetch ban excluding demo_api.gleam) — re-ran both greps in the worktree: zero rsvp/api_helpers matches, gleam/fetch only in demo_api.gleam; lint exits 1 on violation = non-vacuous. (2) demo_reset_wipes_state_test + demo_exit_clears_demo_state_test (FULL for reset/exit; refresh boot path PARTIAL — enter_demo untested). (3) fixtures_conformance_test.gleam decodes all fixtures + encode/decode round-trip through shared/ (FULL). (4) demo_requests_are_intercepted_test asserts the demo branch intercepts dashboard/archived/notifications (FULL).
detail: P0 pillars 100% (no-network lint verified non-vacuous; fixtures drift guard FULL; seam interception FULL; reset/exit FULL with refresh PARTIAL). P1 ~85%: core update-path flows covered but comparison/archive/create-edit covered only at store level, and landing entry CTA + shell demo branches uncovered. Overall >80% (16 new demo tests). CONCERNS band: P0 100%, P1 80-89%.
recommended_fix: Add the six small view/parse tests flagged above (landing CTA, shell demo branches, breadcrumb demo:True, /demo parse, is_demo_route, bug-hunt demo scenario) to lift P1 past 90% into PASS.
